name: realtime
description: A realtime vibration-sensor plot in deterministic screenshot mode. Judge only content inside the plot; ignore headings, descriptions, buttons, controls, and other surrounding UI.

checks.expectation: One coherent vibration plot is visible. Its axes, grid, and waveform stay within the plot area without unintended overlap or clipping. Do not evaluate the Pause control or any other content outside the plot.
The Time before present (s) axis runs from about -20 to 0, and the Acceleration (g) axis shows positive and negative values. Titles and tick labels are readable.
A continuous vibration waveform spans the full twenty-second window with repeated oscillations and occasional taller positive impacts. The curve is visibly varied rather than flat or empty.

Within the plot, axis titles and tick labels are readable and free of clear raster corruption. Fail only for concrete defects such as square pixel blocks, doubled glyphs, or severe stair-step edges that make plot text materially illegible. Do not compare plot text with headings, the Pause control, buttons, controls, or any text outside the plot. Normal antialiasing, small fonts, rotated text, and backend-specific softness are acceptable.
The waveform is distinguishable from the grid and stays in the plot area; axes and plot labels are not blank, corrupted, or materially clipped.
